name: Units publisher (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: every 15 min (launchd com.powos.units-publish, tools/units/publish.sh all): the Mac's units + PowStation's containers and the Colima VM's (over colima ssh) to the PowOS AI page; a host it can't read is republished from its last good snapshot marked stale with the reason. Fetches origin's powos-units each pass
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one bash pass (a git fetch, two snapshots, two publishes, each capped at 4 min) every 15 minutes, niced
